pkgmetadata.longdescription: Provider-agnostic agentic coworker runtime (CLI + server + connectors) by Andrew Ng. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google GenAI, Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock. The PyPI project name is "coworker" while the source repo is "openworker"; this ebuild uses the repo name.

use.flag: Install Playwright integration for the Cowork browser.
Install AWS Bedrock provider via boto3.
